stem: A grouped distribution has class intervals and frequencies: 20-30: 5, 30-40: 12, 40-50: 18, 50-60: 10, 60-70: 5. What is the mode using the grouping formula?

per_option_rationale.rationale: Uses the midpoint of the modal class (40-50 midpoint = 45) instead of applying the interpolation formula. Student takes a shortcut by picking the class midpoint as the mode.
Reports the lower class boundary L = 40 of the modal class without adding the interpolated fraction. Student identifies the correct modal class but stops before the interpolation step.

Computes (f1-f2)/(2*f1-f0-f2) instead of (f1-f0)/(2*f1-f0-f2): uses the wrong difference in the numerator. Mode = 40 + ((18-10)/14)*10 = 40 + (8/14)*10 = 40 + 5.71 = 45.71. Student swaps f0 and f2 in the numerator.

explanation: Modal class is 40-50 (highest frequency 18). f1 = 18, f0 = 12 (class before), f2 = 10 (class after), L = 40, h = 10. Mode = L + ((f1 - f0)/(2*f1 - f0 - f2)) x h = 40 + (6/14) x 10 = 40 + 4.29 = 44.29. The numerator is f1 - f0, not f1 - f2.

explanation_sections.punchline: The numerator in the mode formula is always f1 - f0 (modal minus the class before), not f1 - f2. That gives 6/14 x 10 = 4.29 and mode = 44.29.
explanation_sections.approach: Identify the modal class as the one with the highest frequency; here 40-50 with f1 = 18. Label the class before as f0 = 12 and the class after as f2 = 10. Write the formula: Mode = L + ((f1 - f0)/(2*f1 - f0 - f2)) x h. The numerator is f1 - f0, the excess of the modal class over the class immediately before it. The denominator equals 2 x 18 - 12 - 10 = 14. Substituting: 40 + (6/14) x 10. Verify the denominator is positive before computing.
explanation_sections.lesson: The numerator is f1 - f0, not f1 - f2. Swapping those gives (18 - 10)/14 = 8/14, producing the distractor 45.71. Keep f0 as the class before and f2 as the class after, and do not swap them in the numerator.
explanation_sections.timing: About 75 seconds. Identifying the modal class and labeling f0 and f2 takes 15 seconds. Substituting and computing takes 30 seconds. Distractor 45.71 is the f1 - f2 swap trap; if you see it as your answer, recheck which difference goes in the numerator.
